apps.localizedDescription: SideStore is a fork of AltStore that signs and refreshes sideloaded apps directly on the device. After a one-time pairing-file setup it renews 7-day certificates in the background using your own Apple ID and an anisette server, so apps stop expiring while you are away from a computer. It installs apps from any AltStore-compatible source, keeps them updated, and can back up and restore app data.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SideStore can use local network access to discover Bonjour (mDNS) services on your network. This is not required for core functionality.

compatibility.notes: Official AGPL-3.0 stable releases; the rolling nightly and alpha tags are pre-releases and are not tracked. Requires a pairing file and, on iOS 17+, a JIT/StikDebug-style enabler for some features.
